_readme: Gig sites shown on the Gigs tab. Edit this file to add or change one (keep 'source' so we know where the numbers came from). Numbers are what the sources reported in Oct 2026 and can change. Checked: 2026-10-22.

gigs.name: UserTesting
gigs.needs: Pass a sample test. Computer with mic; some tests on phone.

gigs.name: Userlytics
gigs.paid: PayPal, within 15 days after the client approves

gigs.name: Userfeel
gigs.needs: Watch the intro video and pass a sample test.

gigs.name: Prolific
gigs.pay: Studies must pay at least $8/hr ($12/hr recommended)
gigs.paid: PayPal, $6 minimum. First 4 cash-outs wait 72 hours.
gigs.needs: Waitlist, then ID check. PayPal in your name.

gigs.name: Respondent
gigs.paid: Tremendous (bank, PayPal, gift cards), within 10 days
gigs.needs: Full profile (job, industry, tools). Apply fast: studies fill in hours.

gigs.name: User Interviews
gigs.pay: About $45 per study on average ($60-$250 for some 1-hour sessions)
gigs.needs: Full profile. Only apply to studies that match your real life.

gigs.name: PlaytestCloud
gigs.needs: Qualification test. Phone or tablet games.

gigs.name: Test IO
gigs.pay: $50 per bug you find (more for serious bugs)
gigs.needs: Good at spotting bugs. Great practice for QA / IT jobs.

gigs.name: DataAnnotation
gigs.paid: PayPal, on request, usually a few days
gigs.needs: About 1-hour starter test. No degree needed for general work.

gigs.name: Outlier
gigs.pay: Up to $15/hr generalist; up to $90/hr for personal finance experts
gigs.paid: PayPal, Airtm or bank (ACH), weekly on Tuesdays
gigs.needs: 18+, fluent English, ID check, skill tests.

gigs.name: Alignerr
gigs.needs: Resume or LinkedIn, AI video interview, tests.

gigs.name: Mindrift
gigs.paid: Payoneer or PayPal, twice a month (5th and 20th)
gigs.needs: ID check. Pick fields you know.

gigs.name: Mercor
gigs.needs: 20-min AI video interview, ID + background check.

gigs.name: Handshake AI
gigs.needs: US + work authorization. Needs an associate's degree or higher.

gigs.name: Upwork
gigs.pay: You set it. Upwork keeps 0-15% per contract (about 10% typical).
gigs.paid: Bank or PayPal after the client approves
gigs.needs: Profile + portfolio. Applying costs 'Connects' ($0.15 each, 10 free a month).

gigs.name: Fiverr
gigs.pay: You set it (sell 'gigs' like 'I'll fix your Google Sheet')
gigs.paid: Fiverr keeps a share and holds pay for a while after delivery. Check Fiverr's seller help for current numbers.
gigs.needs: Gig page with examples (your Paycheck Planner screenshots).

gigs.name: HelloTech
gigs.needs: 18+, a car, comfortable setting up computers, Wi-Fi, TVs, smart home.

gigs.name: Field Nation
gigs.pay: Set per work order. Field Nation keeps 10%.
gigs.paid: PayPal or direct deposit, every Friday after the work is approved
gigs.needs: IT field work (installs, setups). Builds a reliability score.

speed_labels.slow: Slower to start (build a profile first)
